storageDesign.remainingIssue: A guest virtual-disk capacity does not alone cap VHDX metadata, WSL-managed host files, staging or shared-VM overhead; verify accounting and enforceable bounds before treating this design as satisfying the aggregate 20 GiB budget.

provisioningPrerequisites: Obtain explicit approval for the bounded image download, new distribution/disk creation, first-start configuration and isolated resource probes; this proposal does not authorize these actions.
Refuse existing distribution-name or installation/staging-path collisions; never adopt, overwrite or unregister an existing distribution.
Bound the download while streaming, reject content beyond 512 MiB, require the pinned SHA256 and fail on HTTP errors; HEAD metadata is not payload verification.
Resolve aggregate host-storage enforcement and whether bootstrap/shared-VM overhead fits the selected resource scope; do not silently reinterpret the agreed budget.
Apply and verify only the new distribution's configuration; if a restart is needed, terminate only the newly owned distribution, never run global WSL shutdown.
Verify virtual-disk capacity and full-filesystem behavior with a small disposable filesystem, then inspect actual cgroup limits and exercise watchdog termination before installing build dependencies.
If limits cannot be enforced without shared WSL changes, stop and obtain a new environment decision.
wslEnvironmentPlan.cleanupPolicy: On failure stop only the newly owned distribution and report its exact name and paths; destructive unregister/disk deletion requires explicit approval and ownership verification.

unresolvedPrerequisites: Verify a hard aggregate 20 GiB incremental-storage bound covering source staging, dependencies, build outputs, image layers and logs; accepted container storage options and df output do not establish enforcement.
Select immutable builder and runtime images; cached stock and diagnostic images are not a matching compiler/dependency closure.
Resolve exact package snapshot, versions, archive checksums, third-party sources and license/source obligations.
Pin configure, menuselect, complete runtime module/dependency closure and separate instrumented-test/release profiles.
Define and validate owned-resource watchdog/cleanup and bounded log/artifact handling for the 30-minute build.
Present the complete build manifest and exact no-unrecorded-fetch commands for explicit Gate B approval.
